seo.title: Account Settings | openIndu
seo.description: Manage your openIndu Community account nickname and profile.

header.title: Account Settings
header.subtitle: Set your community nickname, change your phone number, or delete your account.

profile.cardDescription: Your nickname appears at the account-center entry point once signed in.

role.cardDescription: The current permission level of your account. Regular users can apply to upgrade to Member.
role.approved: Application approved -- sign in again for it to take effect
role.rejected: Application was rejected -- you may re-submit
role.applyFailed: Application failed -- please try again later

submissions.cardDescription: Upload software and documents, and track their review status and feedback.

phoneChange.cardDescription: Changing the phone number tied to your account requires verification by code.

errors.invalidPhone: Enter an 11-digit mainland China phone number
errors.codeSent: Code sent -- please check your messages

deleteAccount.cardDescription: Deleting your account permanently removes it and all related data -- this cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.dialogIntro: This will permanently delete your account, including:
items: All data associated with the account
deleteAccount.warningText: This action cannot be undone -- no data can be recovered after deletion.
